name: Soy Luna
overview: Luna Valente lives with her family in Cancún, Mexico. She goes to school, has her own group of friends, has a job, and loves to skate. However, her life changes when her parents are given a job offer that moves them to Buenos Aires, Argentina. There she finds a new skating rink (named Jam & Roller), learns freestyling, makes new friends, and even falls in love.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: Soy Luna specials include the shorts “Soy Luna on Vacation”, which shows what the main characters did during their vacation before the beginning of the second season, revealing the events that shaped each character’s return. In addition, “The Journey” is a series of retrospective specials released after the end of the series, in which the cast looks back on the journey they experienced during their time on Soy Luna, sharing memories, anecdotes, and reflections on the impact the production had on their lives.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Summer vacation is about to end, and Luna’s parents have decided to accept an unexpected opportunity: to move away from Cancún and start a new life in another country. Luna is not very convinced about leaving behind what makes her happiest: her friends and her afternoons skating, but she is willing to embark on a new adventure. Argentina welcomes her with a wonderful surprise: the skating rink of her dreams! A place where she will spend hours having fun and meet her new best friends.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The school year begins, and Luna’s world is upside down: the Roller is a reality show, new clues from the past visit her in her dreams, and a devastating “accident” puts her passion for skating to the test. When Matteo doesn’t answer her calls and the cameras make everything more complicated, will Luna be able to keep her friends united on the rink? She will have a broken heart and many responsibilities, but nothing will take away her wings.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Luna still has many secrets to uncover about her past and her new life as Sol Benson. Sharon remains undercover and determined to put the relationship between the Valentes and Alfredo in danger. What obstacles will Luna face now that Rey and Maggie are following Sharon’s instructions? In addition, Luna will have to search her heart for sincere answers, as there is a new member at the Roller who is capable of turning her world upside down.
